g.text: Two recalls help. They do not remove every error.
2,000 datasets per scenario. 95% Monte Carlo intervals: normal for bias; Wilson for coverage.
Calibration knows error variance but assumes independent errors. The latent-exposure oracle is not feasible in practice.
